text: Carlo Alberto Galluzzi (1919–2000) was an Italian politician and a member of the Communist Party of Italy. From 1976 to 1989, he served as a Member of the European Parliament. During 1983/1984, he held the position of Chair of the Delegation to the European Parliament/Spanish Cortes Joint Committee. From 1985 until 1987, he served as Chair of the Delegation for relations with Japan. In 1989, he was Vice-Chair of the Delegation for relations with the Member States of ASEAN and the ASEAN Interparliamentary Organisation (AIPO) and the Republic of Korea.
